# Vendored libraries

`supabase.js` is `@supabase/supabase-js` **2.118.0** (the `dist/umd/supabase.js` file from the npm package, MIT licence in
`supabase-js-LICENSE.txt`). It is committed here, pinned, so the admin does not load code from a third-party CDN.
To update: `npm pack @supabase/supabase-js@<version>`, copy `package/dist/umd/supabase.js` over this file, update the version above.
